mapper.sql: SELECT application_id, task_id, designer_id, proposal, proposed_price, estimated_days, portfolio_links, status, feedback, admin_review_status, admin_review_feedback, admin_review_time, admin_review_by, enterprise_review_status, enterprise_review_feedback, enterprise_review_time, review_mode, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag FROM des_task_application
mapper.select: WHERE del_flag = '0' AND review_mode = 'DUAL' AND admin_review_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT ta.application_id, ta.task_id, ta.designer_id, ta.proposal, ta.proposed_price, ta.estimated_days, ta.portfolio_links, ta.status, ta.feedback, ta.admin_review_status, ta.admin_review_feedback, ta.admin_review_time, ta.admin_review_by, ta.enterprise_review_status, ta.enterprise_review_feedback, ta.enterprise_review_time, ta.review_mode, ta.create_by, ta.create_time, ta.update_by, ta.update_time, ta.del_flag FROM des_task_application ta LEFT JOIN des_task t ON ta.task_id = t.task_id WHERE ta.del_flag = '0' AND t.del_flag = '0' AND t.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND ( (ta.review_mode = 'DUAL' AND ta.admin_review_status = 'APPROVED' AND ta.enterprise_review_status = 'PENDING') OR (ta.review_mode = 'ENTERPRISE' AND ta.enterprise_review_status = 'PENDING') ) ORDER BY ta.create_time ASC
ta LEFT JOIN des_task t ON ta.task_id = t.task_id WHERE ta.del_flag = '0' AND t.del_flag = '0' AND t.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} ORDER BY ta.create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ta.enterprise_review_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ta.enterprise_review_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ta.enterprise_review_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rejected_count, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(ta.enterprise_review_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as reviewed_today, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN ta.enterprise_review_status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, ta.create_time, ta.enterprise_review_time) END), 2) as avg_review_hours FROM des_task_application ta LEFT JOIN des_task t ON ta.task_id = t.task_id WHERE ta.del_flag = '0' AND t.del_flag = '0' AND t.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId}
AND ta.create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN admin_review_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN admin_review_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approved_count, SUM(CASE WHEN admin_review_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rejected_count, SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(admin_review_time) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as reviewed_today, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN admin_review_status IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED') THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, admin_review_time) END), 2) as avg_review_hours FROM des_task_application WHERE del_flag = '0' AND review_mode = 'DUAL'
AND create_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}

SELECT ta.application_id as applicationId, ta.task_id as taskId, t.task_title as taskTitle, d.name as designerName, d.avatar as designerAvatar, ta.proposal, ta.proposed_price as proposedPrice, ta.estimated_days as estimatedDays, ta.portfolio_links as portfolioLinks,
CASE WHEN ta.status = '0' THEN 'PENDING' WHEN ta.status = '1' THEN 'PENDING' WHEN ta.status = '2' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN ta.status = '3' THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN ta.status = '4' THEN 'REJECTED' WHEN ta.status = '5' THEN 'WITHDRAWN' ELSE 'PENDING' END as status,
ta.enterprise_review_feedback as feedback, ta.create_time as createTime, ta.enterprise_review_time as reviewTime
FROM des_task_application ta JOIN des_task t ON ta.task_id = t.task_id JOIN des_designer d ON ta.designer_id = d.designer_id WHERE t.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND ta.status IN ('0', '1') AND ta.del_flag = '0' AND t.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY ta.create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageNum}

SELECT ta.*, t.task_title, t.task_description, t.budget_min, t.budget_max, e.enterprise_name, d.name as designer_name, d.avatar as designer_avatar FROM des_task_application ta JOIN des_task t ON ta.task_id = t.task_id JOIN des_enterprise e ON t.enterprise_id = e.enterprise_id JOIN des_designer d ON ta.designer_id = d.designer_id WHERE ta.status = '0' AND ta.admin_review_status = 'PENDING' AND ta.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY ta.create_time ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageNum}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM des_task_application ta JOIN des_task t ON ta.task_id = t.task_id WHERE t.enterprise_id = #{enterpriseId} AND ta.status IN ('0', '1') AND ta.del_flag = '0' AND t.del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM des_task_application ta WHERE ta.status = '0' AND ta.admin_review_status = 'PENDING' AND ta.del_flag = '0'
